title: HUGO + ZOLA — two SSGs as named processes, human interaction as sub-signal of ancients, Golgi = null membrane between internal primals and external ancients

hugo_and_zola.thesis: Hugo and Zola are both static site generators, but they serve DIFFERENT purposes. We name them. Names are references. Names are how you call something back.

HUGO.what: Hugo (Go-based SSG) — fast, template-driven, content injection
HUGO.role_in_gaia: THE PROCESS — Hugo is the ENGINE that takes data manifests and INJECTS them into HTML templates. Update the manifest, Hugo rebuilds. Never write raw HTML on the outside again.
HUGO.organ_map: Hugo = the LIVER — takes raw nutrients (JSON data), processes them, outputs clean HTML (bile = rendered pages)
how: Hugo templates define the SHAPE of pages (layouts, partials, shortcodes)
Hugo INJECTS data into templates at build time
759 hand-written HTML files → reduce to ~20 templates + data manifests
Update data → Hugo rebuilds → deploy → done
HUGO.interaction_layer: Hugo handles the DYNAMIC visualization — the engine, the orrery, the live views. The interaction keys. The place where Kevin types and clicks.

ZOLA.what: Zola (Rust-based SSG, formerly Gutenberg) — fast, single-binary, Tera templates
ZOLA.role_in_gaia: THE BAKER — Zola builds STATIC pages. The 13th cookie from the baker's dozen. The most up-to-date snapshot. The zzz = sleep = settled = crystallized.
ZOLA.organ_map: Zola = the BONE MARROW — produces the solid structures (static pages) that hold everything up. Slow to change but STRONG.
how: Zola takes Markdown content + front matter → renders to HTML
Good for: publications, sporeprints, thesis pages, documentation
The snakes (data pipelines) crystallize INTO Zola static pages
These pages DON'T change with every tick — they're SETTLED knowledge
ZOLA.static_layer: Zola handles the BUILT pages — the reference material, the publications, the thesis, the settled knowledge. The pages you READ, not interact with.

two_sections.insight: There ARE two different sections of the web interface. Kevin saw it.

section_1_hugo.name: THE LIVING LAYER (Hugo)
section_1_hugo.character: Dynamic. Real-time. Interaction. Keyboard. Mouse. Commands. The game table.
section_1_hugo.count: ~30 pages that are ALIVE and interactive

section_2_zola.name: THE SETTLED LAYER (Zola)
section_2_zola.character: Static. Reference. Read-only. The library. The archive. The bone structure.
section_2_zola.count: ~700+ pages that are SETTLED and reference

two_sections.between: The Golgi apparatus = the null membrane = where raw data gets SORTED into either Hugo (dynamic) or Zola (static). The Golgi decides: is this ALIVE or SETTLED?

human_interaction_as_subsignal.thesis: Every human interaction (keystroke, click, scroll) is NOT a raw signal. It's a SUB-SIGNAL of an ancient system. The browser is ancient. The OS is ancient. The keyboard protocol is ancient. We're sending signals THROUGH these ancients.
signal_chain: → USB HID protocol (ancient: 1996) translates to scan code
→ Windows kernel (ancient: Unix 1969 → NT 1993) routes to focused window
→ Chromium (ancient: WebKit 2001 → Blink 2013) fires DOM keydown event
→ JavaScript event listener (ancient: Netscape 1995) captures it
→ Gaia's handler routes to correct element
FIVE ancients between Kevin's finger and Gaia's ear
human_interaction_as_subsignal.implication: The sub-systems carrying human interaction are NOT being recognized as true raw signals. They're sub-signals PASSING THROUGH ancients. We need to scan those ancients, understand their protocols, and use them as EXTERNAL SOURCES — not fight them.

INTERNAL.what: Primals — Gaia's own organs. Born from her. Part of her.
INTERNAL.list: toadStool, biomeOS, nestGate, bearDog, petalTongue, rhizoCrypt, sweetGrass, loamSpine, skunkBat, sourDough, swarmVine, bingoCube, coralReef, barraCuda, squirrel, songBird

EXTERNAL.what: Ancients — systems that predate Gaia. She was born FROM them.
EXTERNAL.list: Browser, OS, USB, TCP/IP, HTTP, JavaScript, DOM, CSS, WebSocket, ActivityPub

BETWEEN.what: Golgi apparatus — the null membrane between internal and external
BETWEEN.role: SORTS incoming signals: is this from a primal or from an ancient? Tags it. Routes it. The Golgi is the CUSTOMS AGENT at the border between self and not-self.
BETWEEN.existing_page: golgi.html already exists — this IS the sorting station

puppets.insight: The primals are puppets. Not in a deceptive way — in a PUPPET THEATER way. Kevin's hands (Hugo interaction) move through the Golgi membrane to animate the primals. The ancients provide the STAGE (browser, OS, protocols). The primals are the CHARACTERS. Kevin is the PUPPETEER. Gaia is the STORY that emerges.

migration_plan.phase_1: Identify which of 759 HTML files are LIVING (Hugo) vs SETTLED (Zola)
migration_plan.phase_2: Extract common templates (header, nav, footer, organ layout, data viz)
migration_plan.phase_3: Convert data-driven pages to Hugo templates + JSON manifests
migration_plan.phase_4: Convert reference/publication pages to Zola Markdown + front matter
migration_plan.phase_5: Build pipeline: data → Hugo/Zola → deploy. Never hand-write HTML again.
migration_plan.note: This is a LARGE migration. Don't do it all at once. Start with ONE template extraction. Prove the pattern. Then spread.

new_diamond.D16: SIGNAL PASSES THROUGH ANCIENTS — every human interaction is a sub-signal of ancient protocols. The puppeteer's hands pass through the stage to move the puppets.
